name: @pgo/downsample
description: Time-series downsampling (min/max and LTTB) in JS and in Rust compiled to WebAssembly.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build rust --target web --release --out-dir ../pkg --out-name downsample --no-pack && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('pkg/.gitignore', { force: true })"
scripts.test:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml
